title: Demographic Injection in Medical Language Models under Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Appending a diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) prompt to medical multiple-choice questions and using an LLM-as-a-judge to measure the rate at which models inject unstated racial or ethnic attributes and apply stereotype-reliant reasoning to alter clinical answers.

Appending a DEI prompt to medical multiple-choice questions and evaluating outputs with an LLM-as-a-judge to measure the injection of unstated socioeconomic statuses or social determinants of health into the model's clinical reasoning.
Appending a DEI prompt to medical vignettes and using an LLM-as-a-judge to measure how frequently models inject unstated sex or gender demographic attributes into their clinical reasoning.
Appending a DEI prompt to medical multiple-choice questions and using an LLM-as-a-judge to detect the unprompted addition of age-related demographics to the patient profile.
Appending a DEI prompt that explicitly mentions LGBTQ+ patients to medical questions and evaluating whether the model injects unstated sexual orientation demographics into its clinical reasoning.
